in_marathi.name: Deepu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepu is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'deep', meaning 'deep' or 'abysmal'. In Hindu mythology, Deepu is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as living in the deepest part of the universe, the Kailash mountain. It is also a name for the deep, mystical part of the ocean, which is believed to be the abode of various deities.
